name: LanDeng Incense Material Database
description: Machine-readable definitions of the functional materials used to make Chinese botanical incense — binders, bases, cores, fuels, and loose aromatic materials. Extracted from the LanDeng (澜灯) incense encyclopedia; values are traceable to source pages and no value is fabricated.
changelog: Added evidenceLevel (Evidence Tier) to 2 source citations; added license, version, and changelog governance fields.

mainEntity.name: Makko
mainEntity.description: Makko (抹香) is the powdered inner bark of the Machilus thunbergii tree (tabunoki), the traditional combustible wood-powder binder of East Asian stick incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: natural binder (combustible wood powder)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: powdered inner bark of Machilus thunbergii (Lauraceae), the tabunoki tree

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: dried and ground inner bark

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: fine, light-colored, nearly odorless powder

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: low-odor / nearly odorless

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: combustible — burns cleanly and evenly, leaving little ash and no glue smell

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: binder and combustion aid for stick, cone and coil incense; forms a workable paste with water that dries into a firm, self-supporting form

mainEntity.name: Bamboo Core
mainEntity.description: A bamboo core is a plant-based combustion base used as the central support of formed stick incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: combustion agent / base (core)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: bamboo

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: coated with incense paste (hand-rolled onto the splint) or machine-coated/dipped in fragrance

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: a thin bamboo splint

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: serves as the combustion base that keeps the stick burning evenly

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: core of stick incense, onto which paste is coated (machine-made/dipped sticks)

mainEntity.name: Wood Powder / Chips
mainEntity.description: Ground aromatic wood — sandalwood (檀香) or agarwood (沉香) powder or chips — is the loose pure-material form that is heated rather than burned to release scent.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: aromatic material (loose wood)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: ground sandalwood (Santalum album) or agarwood (Aquilaria) wood

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: ground into powder or cut into chips

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: loose powder or chips

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: slow, complex aroma as it warms

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: smolders / warms rather than melts; heated indirectly (electric heater or 隔火焚香) for minimal smoke

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: pure-material scent via heating on charcoal or an electric heater; seal-pattern (篆香) powder

mainEntity.name: Resin
mainEntity.description: Dried tree resins — frankincense (乳香) and myrrh (没药) — are loose aromatic materials that melt and release scent when heated.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: aromatic material (loose resin tears)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: dried tree resins (frankincense Boswellia, myrrh Commiphora)

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: tapped gum resins, dried into tears; heated on a charcoal disc or electric heater

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: resin tears that melt on heat

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: rich, fresh scent released on heat

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: melts (rather than smolders); heated, not burned — minimal smoke on an electric heater, more on charcoal

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: indirect-fire (隔火焚香) appreciation; traditional bakhoor-style heating on charcoal

mainEntity.name: Charcoal
mainEntity.description: Charcoal is a combustible filler base used in cheap, synthetic incense to carry a fragrance oil.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: combustion agent / base (synthetic filler)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: charcoal

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: soaked in synthetic fragrance oil

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: burns to carry the fragrance oil

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: filler base in cheap / synthetic incense

mainEntity.name: Sawdust
mainEntity.description: Sawdust is a combustible filler base used in cheap, synthetic incense to carry a fragrance oil.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: combustion agent / base (synthetic filler)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: sawdust

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: soaked in synthetic fragrance oil

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: burns to carry the fragrance oil

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: filler base in cheap / synthetic incense

mainEntity.name: Honey
mainEntity.description: Honey (蜂蜜) is a traditional plant-derived binder and fixative used in classical Chinese incense, including 柏子香 and 合香 blends.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: natural binder / fixative

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: honey (traditionally jujube-flower honey)

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: used to bind powder into pills or sticks; sealed with the material in 柏子香

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: as a processing treatment it softens and sweetens the roasted-seed character (柏子香)

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: acts as a guide/binder — binds the powder into a burnable form

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: traditional binder and fixative in classical 合香 blends; seals 柏子香 seeds

mainEntity.name: Guar Gum
mainEntity.description: Guar gum is a plant-derived natural binder that appears (less centrally than makko) in natural incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: natural binder (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: guar gum (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: plant-derived binder in natural incense

mainEntity.name: Gum Arabic
mainEntity.description: Gum arabic is a plant-derived natural binder that appears (less centrally than makko) in natural incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: natural binder (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: gum arabic (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: plant-derived binder in natural incense

mainEntity.name: Gum Tragacanth
mainEntity.description: Gum tragacanth is a plant-derived natural binder that appears (less centrally than makko) in natural incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: natural binder (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: gum tragacanth (plant gum)

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: plant-derived binder in natural incense

mainEntity.name: Synthetic Binder
mainEntity.description: A synthetic binder is a chemical adhesive or gum used in cheap, machine-made incense sticks.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: synthetic binder (chemical adhesive)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: chemical adhesive / gum

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: can impart a glue-like smell

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: can burn unevenly

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: holds cheap machine-made sticks together

mainEntity.name: Fragrance Oil
mainEntity.description: Fragrance oil is a manufactured, often petroleum-derived scent used in synthetic incense in place of real plant material.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: synthetic aromatic material

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: manufactured scent, often petroleum-derived, with no plant material behind it

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: soaked onto a charcoal or sawdust base

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: a manufactured liquid scent (dipped/coated onto a base)

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: strong, uniform, often 'perfumey'

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: carried on a neutral base (charcoal/sawdust) that burns; fragrance-oil sticks burn with a louder, uniform 'perfumy' character

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: the aromatic component of dipped / fragrance-oil sticks

mainEntity.name: Cypress Seed
mainEntity.description: 柏子 (bǎi zǐ) — the seed of the oriental arborvitae (Platycladus orientalis, 侧柏) — is the single humble material of 柏子香, the scholar's incense.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: aromatic material (seed)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: seeds of the oriental arborvitae (Platycladus orientalis, 侧柏)

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: scalded in boiling water, soaked in wine, sealed with honey for seven days, then dried in the shade

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: green, unopened seeds; a loose roasted material (not a pressed stick)

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: roasted-seed character, softened and sweetened by the honey-and-wine soak

additionalProperty.name: Burning behavior
additionalProperty.value: burned as loose roasted seed on charcoal or an electric heater (not a pressed stick)

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: the single-material 柏子香 incense; a cheap, simple scholar's incense

mainEntity.name: White Plum
mainEntity.description: 白梅 (bái méi) — the dried/pickled white plum — is the fruit material that builds the tart-sweet 'plum' character in the 梅花香 (plum-blossom) accord.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: aromatic material (dried fruit)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: white plum (白梅), the dried/pickled plum fruit

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: roasted dry and ground to a coarse powder, then aged (窨) in a sealed vessel for a month before burning

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: tart-sweet 'plum' character — an accord, not the flower

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: the 佐 (assistant) 'plum' note in 梅花香 / 寿阳公主梅花香

sources.title: 寿阳公主梅花香 (Shouyang Princess's Plum Incense)

mainEntity.name: Clove Powder
mainEntity.description: 丁香 (dīngxiāng) — the dried flower bud of Syzygium aromaticum — is a warm-spice aromatic material used ground or whole in 合香 blends.

additionalProperty.name: Type
additionalProperty.value: aromatic material (spice — dried flower bud)

additionalProperty.name: Source
additionalProperty.value: Syzygium aromaticum dried flower buds (丁香)

additionalProperty.name: Processing
additionalProperty.value: buds harvested before opening and dried; sold whole or ground

additionalProperty.name: Physical characteristics
additionalProperty.value: dark, brown 'nail'-shaped dried buds

additionalProperty.name: Aroma
additionalProperty.value: spicy, warm, aromatic (eugenol)

additionalProperty.name: Applications
additionalProperty.value: spice accent in 合香 blends; a five-spice (五香粉) component
